messages.author: 75f14725dcf2f7dc
messages.subject: Vanilla dartR
parts:
Hi Luis/Bernd,
After being prompted by this message, I did what it said:

Be aware that owing to CRAN requirements and compatibility reasons not all functions of the packages may run yet, as some dependencies could be missing. Hence for a most enjoyable experience we recommend to run the function 
gl.install.vanilla.dartR()
This installs all missing and required packages for your version of dartR. 
For citation information please use:
citation('dartR')

**** Have fun using dartR! ****
Warning message:
package ‘dartR’ was built under R version 4.0.5 

> gl.install.vanilla.dartR()
You have installed dartR 1.9.9.1
Have fun using Vanilla dartR!

Then doing a pcoa  I experienced this:
> D <- gl.dist.pop(gl_x,v=3)
> gl.pcoa.plot(pcoa,D,xaxis=1,yaxis=2)
Starting gl.pcoa.plot 
Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable)  : 
  unable to find an inherited method for function ‘pop’ for signature ‘"dist"’

Was something omitted from the vanilla build?
David Berman
dartR Associate
0412  259585
